# wallix-bastion_config_x509_ocsp (Data Source)

Get information on the OCSP revocation check of the certificates used for X509 authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wallix-bastion_config_x509_ocsp" "current" {}

output "ocsp_responder" {
  value = data.wallix-bastion_config_x509_ocsp.current.default_ocsp_responder
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `default_ocsp_responder` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ocsp_check` (Boolean)
- `ocsp_proxy` (String, Sensitive)
- `override_ocsp_responder` (Boolean)

## Usage Notes

`config_x509_ocsp` is a singleton, so this data source takes no arguments. It reads the
configuration managed by the `wallix-bastion_config_x509_ocsp` resource.
